investigations.name: annotation-organ-matching
investigations.title: Annotation-Based Organ Matching — SBML MIRIAM + BTO Crosswalk Provenance
investigations.objective:
How does a BioModels entry get tagged with an HRA Uberon organ when the
match comes from its embedded SBML MIRIAM annotations rather than its
name — and which biological CVTerm qualifiers / ontologies actually carry
that organ signal?

investigations.name: annotation-recall-gain
investigations.title: Annotation Recall Gain — Annotation-Matching vs Name-Only Organ Tagging
investigations.objective:
How much organ/model coverage does annotation-based organ matching (SBML
MIRIAM + BTO crosswalk) add over the existing name-synonym matcher
(`glucose-biomodel-do`/`corpus-coverage`), across the full 1,096-model
curated BioModels corpus?

investigations.name: atlas-pipeline
investigations.title: HRA Computational Model Atlas — the end-to-end, reproducible build pipeline
investigations.objective:
How is the HRA Computational Model Atlas actually built — end to end, from
external model repositories and Human Reference Atlas services down to the
atlas.json the 3D viewer renders — and can that whole build be run as ONE
connected process-bigraph composite that reproducibly regenerates the same
artifact offline, with every stage visible and connectable in the modules tab?

investigations.name: biomodel-hra-map
investigations.title: BioModels → HRA Map — Harvesting the Curated Corpus into the Human Reference Atlas
investigations.objective:
Can we harvest the entire curated BioModels corpus into a single, reusable
JSON DB that links each model to the Human Reference Atlas — molecular
identifiers (CHEBI/UniProt/KEGG/GO/Reactome), publication link, organism,
and HRA organ / FTU / cell-type mapping (Uberon/CL) — as a downloadable
workspace resource the Atlas Browser and downstream coverage studies can
key off, and how much of the corpus does each annotation actually reach?

investigations.name: blood-vasculature-network
investigations.title: Blood Vasculature Network — VCCF transport graph to couple organ models
investigations.objective:
Can the HRA/VCCF vasculature data define a whole-body blood-transport
network — a directed heart -> organ -> heart circuit through named vessels —
that we can use to COUPLE independent organ simulations by advecting shared
blood-borne solutes (glucose, O2, insulin, ...) between them? And what does a
v1 blood-circulation simulation over that network look like?

investigations.name: corpus-coverage
investigations.title: Corpus Coverage — Full 1,096-Model BioModels Catalog on HRA 3D Anatomy
investigations.objective:
Of the HRA ASCT+B-3D crosswalk's 1,730 Uberon-keyed anatomical structures
(across 114 source-organ GLBs), how many are covered once every curated
BioModels model — not just a narrow search query — is crossed against
them, and does full-corpus coverage reach organs a single-query search
misses (e.g. kidney)?

investigations.name: ctpop-islet-parameterization
investigations.title: CTpop -> Topp2000 Islet Parameterization — Beta-Cell Composition Shifts the Glucose Setpoint
investigations.objective:
Does binding HRA CTpop islet cell-type composition to the Topp2000
beta-cell-mass model (BIOMD0000000341) change the predicted glucose
regulation -- realizing the RUI -> CTpop -> model parameterization vision
Katy Boerner / Peter Hunter / SPARC describe, for the pancreatic islet FTU
`ftu-model-coverage` already found covered?

investigations.name: ftu-glomerulus
investigations.title: FTU Glomerulus — 3D Functional-Tissue-Unit Digital Object
investigations.objective:
Does the HRA CDN's glomerulus 3D functional-tissue-unit (FTU) digital
object load into a Step-driven composite, giving a sub-organ-scale 3D
asset (below the per-organ reference-organ GLBs) that could anchor
finer-grained model coverage?

investigations.name: ftu-model-coverage
investigations.title: FTU Model Coverage — Do Existing BioModels Model HRA Functional Tissue Units?
investigations.objective:
Do existing BioModels model HRA functional tissue units (FTUs) -- Katy
Boerner's question -- and, for the FTUs that already have models, can HRA
CTpop (Cell Type Populations) cell-type counts parameterize them, per the
RUI -> CTpop -> model vision Peter Hunter and SPARC-heart describe?

investigations.name: glucose-biomodel-do
investigations.title: Glucose BioModel Digital Objects — Uberon Organ Annotation
investigations.objective:
Can glucose-regulation BioModels be annotated with HRA Uberon organ terms
(via transparent synonym matching) and inverted into an organ->models index?

investigations.name: glucose-regulation
investigations.title: Glucose Regulation — COPASI vs Tellurium
investigations.objective:
Do COPASI and Tellurium agree on the dynamics of BioModels matching
"glucose regulation"?

investigations.name: hra-3d-crosswalk
investigations.title: HRA 3D Crosswalk — Full ASCT+B-3D Anatomical-Structure Tree
investigations.objective:
Does the HRA CDN's ASCT+B-3D models crosswalk load into a Step-driven
composite, giving the full 1,400+ anatomical-structure (AS) tree — not
just the ~81 per-organ reference-organ GLBs — with resolvable Uberon CURIEs
and source-organ GLB names?

investigations.name: hra-anatomical-structures
investigations.title: HRA Anatomical-Structure Term Occurrences
investigations.objective:
Does the HRA CCF API's ontology-term-occurences endpoint load into a
Step-driven composite, giving an anatomical-structure term occurrence list?

investigations.name: hra-atlas-browser
investigations.title: HRA Computational Model Atlas — organ selector + model-count gradient + subregion placement
investigations.objective:
Can we present the full HRA-3D model-coverage picture as an interactive
atlas — pick any of the 50 GLB-backed HRA organs, see it colored by how many
mechanistic models are associated with it, browse straight to those
BioModels — AND go one level deeper, placing models at the specific organ
SUBREGIONS (anatomical structures) their cell types / FTUs resolve to,
rather than distributing every model uniformly across the whole organ?

investigations.name: hra-cell-types
investigations.title: HRA Cell-Type Term Occurrences
investigations.objective:
Does the HRA CCF API's cell-type-term-occurences endpoint load into a
Step-driven composite, giving a Cell Ontology (CL) term occurrence list?

investigations.name: hra-reference-organs
investigations.title: HRA Reference Organs — Uberon-Keyed Organ Set
investigations.objective:
Does the HRA CCF API's reference-organs endpoint load into a Step-driven
composite, giving an Uberon-keyed organ set (with per-sex GLB assets)?

investigations.name: kidney-model-simulation
investigations.title: Kidney model simulation — run every atlas-mapped kidney model in its compatible simulator
investigations.objective:
Can we take the models the atlas maps to an organ — kidney — pull every one,
load each into its COMPATIBLE simulator (SBML BioModels under COPASI, CellML
Physiome models under OpenCOR), run each to a timeseries, and present all of
them together in one interactive dashboard that shows both the models that run
(with real trajectories) and the ones that don't (with the reason)?

investigations.name: model-coverage-3d
investigations.title: Model Coverage 3D — AS/Organ Coverage from BioModel-DO Annotations
investigations.objective:
Of the HRA ASCT+B-3D crosswalk's 1,400+ anatomical structures (and ~81
reference organs), which are covered by a mechanistic model — and can
that coverage be viewed directly on the 3D anatomy?

investigations.name: model-harvest
investigations.title: Unified Model Harvest — BioModels + PhysioNet into the HRA Model DB
investigations.objective:
Can a single Step reproduce/refresh the unified HRA model DB
(datasets/model_hra_map.json) across every registered model source --
BioModels and, newly, PhysioNet -- incrementally and non-destructively, so
that running this study *is* the reproducibility hook for the whole DB,
not just a read of a static file?

investigations.name: spatial-linkage
investigations.title: Spatial Linkage — Model -> AS -> GLB Scene-Node Links
investigations.objective:
For each biomodel-DO organ annotation, exactly which ASCT+B-3D crosswalk
GLB scene node(s) does it correspond to — precise enough for a 3D viewer
to color/label the right node per model?
